appart.consigne: A small cozy modern Paris apartment living room at night: a grey sofa with cushions, a coffee table, a warm floor lamp, string lights, plants, a big window with Paris rooftops and city lights at night. Warm lamp light and cool blue night light from the window.

chambre_peche.consigne: A luxurious pink influencer bedroom at night: a big bed with white and pink pillows and a fluffy blanket, a ring light, a wall of mirrors, gold decorations, pink and purple neon glow without any letters.

rue.consigne: A narrow Paris street at night in heavy rain: wet cobblestones reflecting colorful neon lights, a café with a red awning, neon signs shaped like cherries, lemons and hearts with no letters at all, parked scooters, old street lamps, Haussmann buildings, rain falling. Cinematic blue and orange light.

cuisine.consigne: A small warm old-fashioned grandmother's kitchen at night: wooden cupboards, floral wallpaper, copper pans hanging, a pot on an old stove, a round table with a checkered tablecloth and a teapot, a warm yellow ceiling lamp, a window with rain outside.

fete.consigne: A glamorous party hall at night: crystal chandeliers, gold and white balloons, round tables with white tablecloths and candles, a small stage with a white rose arch and a microphone stand. The guests are fruit people with colorful fruit-colored skin (banana yellow, grape purple, apple green, orange), small, far away and blurred in the background.

fete_portes.consigne: The entrance of a glamorous party hall at night seen from inside: tall golden double doors wide open, bright light coming from behind the doors, crystal chandeliers, gold and white balloons, round tables with candles. A few guests seen from behind and blurred at the edges of the frame are fruit people with colorful fruit-colored skin (banana yellow, grape purple, apple green). The doorway itself is empty.

plans.cadre: Medium close-up from the waist up, she stands in the living room and holds a smartphone up toward the viewer with one hand, shocked and angry, eyes wet.
plans.jeu: She holds up the phone toward the viewer, furious and hurt, and shouts
plans.replique: Pourquoi Pêche t'écrit : tu m'as manqué cette nuit ?!

plans.cadre: Medium shot, he sits relaxed on the grey sofa, one arm on the backrest, lazy smirk.
plans.jeu: He shrugs casually with a lazy smirk and says
plans.replique: Calme-toi… C'est rien, c'est pour le boulot.

plans.cadre: Close-up of her face and shoulders, tears in her eyes, angry.
plans.jeu: Tears in her eyes, she snaps back angrily
plans.replique: T'as pas de boulot, Citron !

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, he stands and leans forward aggressively, pointing his finger at the viewer, angry.
plans.jeu: He points his finger angrily and shouts
plans.replique: T'as fouillé mon téléphone ? T'es malade !

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, she holds a smartphone in front of her face as if starting a video call, tears on her cheeks, determined.
plans.jeu: She wipes a tear, lifts the phone and says firmly
plans.replique: Très bien. J'appelle Pêche.

plans.cadre: Selfie-style close-up as seen through a phone front camera: she lies on her bed, holding the phone at arm's length, smug fake smile.
plans.jeu: She gives a slow fake smile, tilts her head and says in a mocking drawl
plans.replique: Ah… Salut ma belle.

plans.cadre: Close-up of her face looking at a phone screen just below the frame, shocked, lips trembling.
plans.jeu: Shocked, her voice breaking, she whispers
plans.replique: Ce sweat… C'est celui de Citron.

plans.cadre: Selfie-style close-up: she sits on her bed and raises her left hand toward the viewer to show a big diamond engagement ring on her finger, smug.
plans.jeu: She shows off the big diamond ring to the camera with a smug smile and says
plans.replique: Il t'a pas dit ? Il m'a demandée en mariage.

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, he stands with his arms crossed over his muscular chest, cold contemptuous look.
plans.jeu: Arms crossed, with a cold contemptuous look, he says slowly
plans.replique: Elle a deux cent mille abonnés. Toi, t'es serveuse.
plans.sous_titre: Elle a 200 000 abonnés. Toi, t'es serveuse.

plans.cadre: Wide shot, she runs alone down the rainy street at night toward the viewer, crying, rain soaking her hair.
plans.jeu: She runs toward the camera in the pouring rain, crying, out of breath

plans.cadre: Medium shot, he sits on a green delivery scooter stopped in the rainy street, wearing his cap, worried, looking at the viewer.
plans.jeu: Worried, he takes off his helmet visor and calls out
plans.replique: Cerise ?! Qu'est-ce qu'il t'a fait ?

plans.cadre: Close-up of her face in the rain at night, crying, wet hair.
plans.jeu: Crying in the rain, she turns away and murmurs
plans.replique: Laisse-moi, Kiwi…

plans.cadre: Medium shot, she stands at the stove pouring tea into a cup, looking at the viewer over her glasses with a wise mischievous look.
plans.jeu: She pours the tea calmly, looks over her glasses and says with a mischievous smile
plans.replique: Un citron, ma chérie… Ça finit toujours pressé.

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, she sits at the kitchen table wrapped in a soft blanket, wet hair, holding a cup of tea with both hands, sad.
plans.jeu: Sad, holding her cup of tea, she says quietly
plans.replique: Il a dit que j'étais rien, Mamie.

plans.cadre: Close-up, she takes off her small round glasses, serious and determined.
plans.jeu: She takes off her glasses, serious, and says firmly
plans.replique: Rien ? Alors montre-lui ce que vaut une cerise.

plans.cadre: Medium shot, he stands in the kitchen doorway holding his phone, shocked.
plans.jeu: Shocked, he looks up from his phone and says
plans.replique: Cerise… Regarde ce qu'il vient de poster.

post.texte: Fiançailles samedi 🍋💍🍑 Tout le quartier est invité !

plans.cadre: Close-up of her face, the realization dawning, eyes wide, horrified.
plans.jeu: Horrified, realizing the truth, she says
plans.replique: Trois mille euros… C'est l'argent de l'opération de Mamie !
plans.sous_titre: 3 000 €… C'est l'argent de l'opération de Mamie !

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, he clenches his fist, outraged.
plans.jeu: Outraged, he clenches his fist and says
plans.replique: Il a pris tes économies pour lui acheter une bague ?!

plans.cadre: Close-up, she puts her glasses back on slowly, calm and determined, a small dangerous smile.
plans.jeu: Calm and determined, she puts her glasses back on and says
plans.replique: Samedi… On ira à cette fête.

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, he raises his eyebrows, surprised and curious.
plans.jeu: Surprised, he raises his eyebrows and asks
plans.replique: Et on fait quoi, là-bas ?

plans.cadre: Close-up, she wipes away her tears, her face becomes determined and strong.
plans.jeu: She wipes away her tears, her face hardens with determination, and she says
plans.replique: On récupère la bague. Et l'argent de Mamie.

plans.cadre: Medium shot, he stands on the small stage under the white rose arch and holds a microphone, smiling proudly at the crowd.
plans.jeu: Proud, smiling at the crowd, he speaks into the microphone
plans.replique: Pêche… Devant tout le quartier… Veux-tu…

plans.cadre: Wide shot, she stands in the open doorway, backlit, confident and glamorous, full body, blurred guests in the foreground turning their heads toward her.
plans.jeu: She stands still in the doorway, then walks forward slowly and confidently, her dress moving, guests turning around

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, she stands on the stage, furious, pointing toward the doors.
plans.jeu: Furious, she points toward the doors and shouts
plans.replique: Qu'est-ce qu'elle fait là, elle ?!

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, he stands on the stage, nervous, sweating, gesturing to someone off-screen.
plans.jeu: Nervous and sweating, he waves to the security guards and shouts
plans.replique: Sécurité ! Sortez-la d'ici !

plans.cadre: Medium shot, she stands near the open doors raising her wooden spoon threateningly, fierce mischievous look.
plans.jeu: She raises her wooden spoon threateningly and says
plans.replique: Touchez-la, et je vous transforme en compote.

plans.cadre: Medium close-up, she stands on the stage under the chandeliers holding a microphone, calm, confident little smile.
plans.jeu: Calm and confident, she lifts the microphone and says with a little smile
plans.replique: Avant le oui… J'ai une petite vidéo à vous montrer.

plans.cadre: Close-up of his face on the stage, his smile dropping, panicked, a drop of sweat.
plans.jeu: His smile slowly drops into panic, he swallows hard
